title: Successful PostgreSQL migration and persistence remain unexecuted in the captured audit
trigger: Evaluate the configured PostgreSQL adapter as deployment-ready without a dedicated synthetic database run.
expected: Run the real migration, replay, owner isolation, revision conflict, bytes, delete/tombstone sequence against a disposable database and retain its results before treating the adapter as verified.
actual: The gated realDatabaseRoundtripAndMigrations test was skipped because REVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL was not supplied. The audit runner verified build, mock/local suites and unreachable-DB failure only.
impact: Source review supports the SQL design, but cannot prove the actual server/database integration, TLS chain, migration permissions, quota races or cross-restart persistence. Live Tiger credentials and services were deliberately not used.
evidence: reports/17-evidence-runner.md r1-12 (dedicated DB test skipped), r1-14 (unreachable PostgreSQL fails closed in ~20s); PostgresStore.swift:27-65,79-113,116-160,165-189; Migrations/001_snapshot.sql.
smallestFix: Run a disposable local PostgreSQL test environment with sanitized configuration when available, then separately verify configured deployment/Tiger without conflating it with local evidence. Review later account migration in its own captured delta.
regressionCheck: Dedicated DB gate passes on fresh schema and rerun; concurrent same-owner CAS has one winner, concurrent quota attempts cannot oversubscribe, owner-B reads fail, restart retains exact data, and deletion preserves tombstone semantics.
reviewerProvenance: Codex continuation after user reported Claude usage exhaustion; source review only, not Fable output.
